title: studio(interfaces): create flows for list views, dashboards, reports and pages in a writable package (ADR-0084), after #11790's nav item types
body:
Blocked-by: objectstack-ai/objectui#11790

Filed by the triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015, `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U`) as the foreseen second step of objectstack-ai/objectui#11790. ⛔ Not a claim.

Governing text: ADR-0084 (Accepted). The Interface pillar holds app · page · view · form · dashboard · report, and its editor is "a **builder** (canvas + palette) or **source + preview**" (objectstack `docs/adr/0084-application-builder-information-architecture.md:46`).

## What is missing (measured in the 2026-10-07 QA pass, on objectui#11790)

- Studio's create dialogs exist for app, object, flow and permission set only. A writable package cannot create a list or form view, a dashboard, a report or a page.
- The object canvas' Properties panel edits nothing ("nothing here is edited from this panel").

## Direction, in this order

1. **List view:** columns, filters and sort in that Properties panel, saved to the package draft.
2. **Dashboard and report:** a create flow that opens the structured canvas (objectstack `docs/design/builder-ui.md` §6).
3. **Page:** a create flow that opens source plus live preview.

Each step may land as its own PR under this card.

## Why blocked

#11790 first adds every nav item type to the same nav editor, so a surface created here can be linked at once. Both cards edit `packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`.

`Clause-②: no`. Patch changesets in objectui.

Dedupe: `studio interfaces create dashboard report page list view` · `ADR-0084 Interface pillar create flow` · `#11790 step 2`.
